title_sq: Garsoniere per shitje ne Ali Dem
description_sq:
Garsoniera ka siperfaqe totale 34.5 m2 dhe ndodhet te Ali Demi, 100 m mbi shkollen Kushtrimi Lirise Tiranë.
Kati 2 teresisht i rinovuar ne nje pallat egzistues.
E mobiluar plotësisht me stil bashkëkohor: Ambient open-space me ajer te kondicionuar,WiFi , kuzhinë moderne me pajisje të gjitha të reja.
Tualet me dritare per ajerosje natyrale , gjithcka te nevojshme e,funksionale te pershtatshme direkt per banim, investim Airbnb ose qera afatgjate.
Prona disponon Certifikate Pronesise.
Cmimi 86.000 euro.
Nuk shitet me kredi.
Per momentin garsoniera eshte e dhene me qera mujore 400 euro.
title_en: Studio for sale in Ali Dem
description_en: The studio has a total area of ​​34.5 m2 and is located in Ali Demi, 100 m above the Kushtrimi Lirise school in Tirana. 2nd floor completely renovated in an existing building. Fully furnished in a contemporary style: open-space environment with air conditioning, WiFi, modern kitchen with all new appliances. Toilets with windows for natural ventilation, everything necessary and functional, suitable directly for housing, Airbnb investment or long-term rent. The property has Certificates of Ownership. The price is 86,000 euros. Not sold on credit. At the moment, the studio is rented for 400 euros per month.
